name: Kawkab Marrakech home match (Botola Pro)
blurb: Top-flight Moroccan football in Marrakech: Kawkab host Botola Pro games, but the December fixture list is not published yet.
priceText: MAD 30 (Kawkab supporters' stands), MAD 100 (West stand), MAD 200 (VIP) at the Kawkab v Wydad match in April 2026; varies by opponent
when: Home date not published yet; Botola Pro runs from 24 Sep 2026 and fixtures come out in blocks (placeholder window)

name: Mo Rocks Weekender 2026 (party weekend)
blurb: Four-night party weekend with pool and beach parties by day and club nights in Agadir; ages 21+, accommodation not included.
priceText: Early-bird entertainment pass from GBP 120 (GBP 50 deposit to secure); other ticket tiers not shown
when: Thu 3 Dec (22:00) to Mon 7 Dec 2026, Agadir clubs and venues; no refunds

name: Carthage Film Days (JCC), 37th edition
blurb: Tunis's big annual film festival, with screenings across the city and low ticket prices; 2026 is the 37th edition.
priceText: TND 5 or 6 per screening, TND 3 for students (2025 edition; 2026 prices not published yet)
when: Sat 12 to Sat 19 Dec 2026 (dates announced by the Ministry of Culture on 12 May 2026)

name: Espérance de Tunis v Zarzis (Ligue 1)
blurb: Home league game for Tunisia's most successful club at the 65,000-seat Radès stadium; the kick-off time is a placeholder.
when: Sat 12 Dec 2026, 16:30 (per FotMob; the league can reschedule), Stade Hammadi-Agrebi, Radès

name: Club Africain v JS Omrane (Ligue 1)
blurb: Club Africain home league game at the Radès stadium, the Tunis rival of Espérance; date and time can still change.
when: Sat 5 Dec 2026, 16:30 (per FotMob; the league can reschedule), Stade Hammadi-Agrebi, Radès

name: Dubai Shopping Festival 2026/27
blurb: Dubai's big winter shopping season: citywide sales, nightly fireworks and drone shows, concerts and daily prize draws.
priceText: No entry fee for the festival itself; concerts and attractions are ticketed separately
when: Expected early Dec 2026 to mid-Jan 2027; dates not announced yet (2025/26 ran 5 Dec 2025 to 11 Jan 2026)

name: Global Village Dubai, Season 31
blurb: Open-air park of national pavilions with street food, shopping, fairground rides and stage shows; Season 31 opens 14 Oct.
when: Daily from 14 Oct 2026 to May 2027; closing day, hours and ticket prices not published yet

name: DP World ILT20 cricket, Season 5 (playoffs and final)
blurb: UAE T20 franchise cricket; games rotate between Dubai, Sharjah and Abu Dhabi, with the final at Dubai International Stadium.
when: League from Sun 22 Nov 2026; playoffs 16-18 Dec, final 20 Dec in Dubai (full match list and ticket prices not found)

name: Formula 1 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix (Yas Marina Circuit)
blurb: Season-finale F1 weekend at Yas Marina in Abu Dhabi, a bus or taxi ride from Dubai; race day is Sunday 6 December.
when: Fri 4 to Sun 6 Dec 2026 (race Sun 6 Dec), Yas Marina Circuit, Abu Dhabi

name: Christmas on A Great Street (Orchard Road light-up)
blurb: Orchard Road's 3 km Christmas light-up, with Christmas villages, a big tree and a Christmas Eve street party.
priceText: Street light-up is free to view; village rides, games and food cost extra
when: 2026 dates not announced; 2025 ran Sat 8 Nov 2025 to Thu 1 Jan 2026, with a Christmas Eve street party

name: Christmas Wonderland at Gardens by the Bay
blurb: Christmas fair at Gardens by the Bay: nightly lights, carnival rides and a food village (2025 format); needs its own ticket.
when: 2026 dates not announced; 2025 ran 29 Nov 2025 to 1 Jan 2026, 18:30-23:00 nightly (last entry 22:15)

name: BYD Singapore International Marathon weekend
blurb: Running weekend from the F1 Pit Building to the National Stadium: night 5K and 10K on Friday, half and full marathon at dawn.
priceText: Runner entry, international rates: 5 km S$118, 10 km S$150, half marathon S$188, marathon S$208
when: Fri 4 Dec (10K 20:30, 5K 21:30), Sat 5 Dec (half, 04:30), Sun 6 Dec 2026 (marathon, 04:30); 5K/10K entries close 31 Oct

name: BTS World Tour 'ARIRANG' in Singapore (National Stadium)
blurb: Four BTS stadium nights at the National Stadium; all sold out, so expect busy hotels and resale prices (only 17 Dec is in 4-18 Dec).
priceText: $148 to $388 face value (SGD, excl. booking fee); sold out
when: Thu 17, Sat 19, Sun 20 and Tue 22 Dec 2026, 19:00, National Stadium

name: Marunouchi Illumination 2026-27
blurb: Winter light-up along the Marunouchi avenue beside Tokyo Station, free to walk through every evening.
priceText: Free
when: 12 Nov 2026 to 14 Feb 2027 per a season guide; evening hours not yet published (2025/26: 16:00-23:00)

name: Roppongi Hills Keyakizaka Illumination and Christmas Market
blurb: Zelkova-lined Keyakizaka street lit up with Tokyo Tower in view; a Christmas market runs nearby at O-yane Plaza.
priceText: Illumination street is free, no ticket needed; market entry not stated
when: Illumination 5 Nov to 25 Dec 2026, 17:00-22:00; market 21 Nov to 25 Dec, 11:00-21:00 (per a 2026-27 season guide)

name: Midtown Christmas 2026 (Tokyo Midtown, Roppongi)
blurb: Free evening Christmas light displays in the Midtown Garden, plus a paid ice rink from 5 December.
priceText: Free, no reservation; the ice rink is paid (price not stated)
when: 26 Nov to 25 Dec 2026, 17:00-23:00; ice rink 5 Dec 2026 to 23 Feb 2027, 11:00-21:00 (per a 2026-27 season guide)

name: Shibuya Blue Cave (Ao no Dokutsu)
blurb: Walk-through tunnel of blue LED lights in Shibuya, a free evening stroll that gets very crowded at weekends.
priceText: Free
when: 2026 dates not announced; 2025 ran 4-25 Dec, 17:00-22:00

name: Setagaya Boroichi (street flea market)
blurb: Centuries-old two-day street market of used kimono, antiques and street food; the ward counts about 200,000 visitors a day.
priceText: Free to enter; stalls sell second-hand goods and food
when: Tue 15 and Wed 16 Dec 2026 (held every 15-16 Dec and 15-16 Jan), 09:00-20:00; no parking

name: Seoul Lantern Festival (Cheonggyecheon)
blurb: Hundreds of lantern and light sculptures along the Cheonggyecheon stream, a free evening walk through central Seoul.
priceText: Free (2025 edition)
when: 2026 dates not announced (one listing guesses 13-29 Nov); 2025 ran 12 Dec 2025 to 4 Jan 2026, 18:00-22:00 nightly

name: Gwanghwamun Christmas Market and Seoul Light
blurb: European-style Christmas village on Gwanghwamun Square with a big tree, carousel and ~100 stalls, plus a media-art light show.
priceText: No entry fee stated; open public square event (2025 edition)
when: 2026 dates not announced; 2025: market 12-31 Dec, Seoul Light 12 Dec to 4 Jan, evenings from about 17:30-18:00 to 21:30-22:00

name: Atelier de Noël at The Hyundai Seoul (Yeouido)
blurb: Christmas pop-up village inside The Hyundai Seoul department store; entry was free in 2025 but needed an advance reservation.
priceText: Free, reservation required (2025 edition)
when: 2026 dates not announced; 2025 ran 1 Nov to 25 Dec

name: BTS World Tour 'ARIRANG' in Bangkok
blurb: Three BTS stadium nights at Rajamangala; all sold out, so expect packed hotels and high resale prices around 3-6 Dec.
when: Thu 3, Sat 5 and Sun 6 Dec 2026, Rajamangala National Stadium; all three shows sold out

name: National Day and Father's Day (5 December)
blurb: Public holiday honouring the late King Bhumibol, with yellow decorations and candlelit ceremonies around the city.
priceText: Free to join
when: Sat 5 Dec 2026 (annual public holiday; Constitution Day follows on Thu 10 Dec)

name: Vijit Chao Phraya Light Festival
blurb: Annual light festival that transforms Bangkok's Chao Phraya riverside with illuminated displays and colour after dark.
when: 9 Nov to 23 Dec 2026 per a December-events guide; organiser dates, hours and entry price not checked

name: Tomorrowland Thailand (Pattaya)
blurb: Three-day edition of the Belgian dance festival at Wisdom Valley near Pattaya, a couple of hours from Bangkok; reported sold out.
priceText: THB 5,100 for a 1-day pass, THB 12,500 for 3 days (listing); 2026 edition reported sold out, waitlist only
when: Fri 11 to Sun 13 Dec 2026, Wisdom Valley, Pattaya (Chonburi)

name: Wonderfruit 2026 (Chonburi)
blurb: Five-day music, art and food festival at Siam Country Club near Pattaya, a couple of hours from Bangkok; tickets on a waitlist.
when: Thu 3 to Mon 7 Dec 2026, The Fields at Siam Country Club, Chonburi; waitlist open, ticket prices not shown

name: BTS World Tour 'ARIRANG' in Kuala Lumpur
blurb: Two BTS stadium nights at Bukit Jalil; both sold out, so expect full hotels and high resale prices on 12-13 Dec.
when: Sat 12 and Sun 13 Dec 2026, 19:30, TM Stadium Nasional, Bukit Jalil; sold out

name: Khalid, It's Always Summer Somewhere Tour
blurb: US R&B singer Khalid plays one night at idea Live Arena on his world tour.
priceText: From RM 358 (per Harper's Bazaar Malaysia)
when: Wed 9 Dec 2026, idea Live Arena; date from two media listings, ticket page not readable

name: Christmas displays at Pavilion KL and Suria KLCC
blurb: Free mall Christmas displays in Bukit Bintang and at KLCC: big trees, lights and live performances through December.
priceText: Free
when: Pavilion KL from November, Suria KLCC until late December; exact 2026 dates not published (window set to December)

name: X National Games (Thong Nhat Stadium)
blurb: Vietnam's national multi-sport games, with athletics and football at Thong Nhat Stadium; closing ceremony expected there on 12 Dec.
when: 20 Nov to 12 Dec 2026, Ho Chi Minh City and two other provinces; public access and tickets not stated

name: Christmas lights at Nguyen Hue, Notre-Dame and Tan Dinh Church
blurb: Christmas lights along the Nguyen Hue walking street and around Notre-Dame Cathedral and Tan Dinh's pink church; free to wander.
priceText: Free (street decorations)
when: Through December; no official switch-on date found (window set to December), Christmas Eve is the peak night
